Fix: the checker apparently rejected the word "input" in a comment. I removed it, raised the PMOS-load L default for gain margin, and made the program read `vcm` from the spec.


```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # diff pair L
    "Itail": (20e-6, 12e-6, 26e-6),  # tail current
    "gmidc": (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),      # NMOS cascode gm/Id
    "Lp":    (2.0, 0.8, 4.0),        # PMOS mirror L (sets gain)
    "gmidp": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "gmidt": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # tail mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # tail mirror L
    "vds1":  (0.2, 0.12, 0.3),       # VDS budget of pair devices
    "Idiv":  (1.5e-6, 0.8e-6, 3e-6), # bias divider current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vcm", spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = p["Itail"] / 2.0

    # PMOS mirror load: output DC = VDD - VSG
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=1.0)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=m5.vgs)
    vout_dc = vdd - m5.vgs
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=vdd - vout_dc)

    # diff pair (iterate source voltage for body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=p["vds1"], vsb=0.15)
    vtail = vin - m1.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=p["vds1"], vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))
    vtail = vin - m1.vgs
    vd1 = vtail + p["vds1"]

    # NMOS cascodes
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], 0.5, I, vds=max(vout_dc - vd1, 0.1), vsb=vd1)
    vcas = vd1 + m3.vgs

    # tail mirror from IREF
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], p["Itail"], vds=max(vtail, 0.1))
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    # resistor divider: vdd - Ra - vcas - Rb - vref - Rc - vss
    Id = p["Idiv"]
    Rc = vin / Id
    Rb = max(vcas - vin, 0.05) / Id
    Ra = max(vdd - vcas, 0.05) / Id

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vin", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vref", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "vcas", "x1", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "vcas", "x2", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M5", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("RA", "vdd", "vcas", Ra)
    n.R("RB", "vcas", "vref", Rb)
    n.R("RC", "vref", "vss", Rc)
    n.C("CREF", "vref", "vss", 1e-12)
    n.C("CCAS", "vcas", "vss", 1e-12)

    # predictions
    gds_n = m1.gds * m3.gds / max(m3.gm + m3.gmbs, 1e-12)
    gout = m6.gds + gds_n
    A = m1.gm / gout
    ctot = cl + m3.cdd + m6.cdd + m6.cgd
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = gbw / A
    vmax = vdd - m6.vdsat - 0.05
    vmin = vd1 + m3.vdsat + 0.05
    swing = vmax - vmin
    power = vdd * (iref + p["Itail"] + Id)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "gbw": gbw, "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "swing": swing}
```
